findings.evidence: The summary calls the classes of t, t-1 and their images Lie-algebra generators. These classes belong to the cotangent space m_e/m_e^2; Lie(G) is its dual. Replace them by the dual functionals taking those classes to 1, as established in the repaired assigned items. B-page prose is outside this reader's edit authority.

The formula theta(1 tensor dx)=x mod m^2 is asserted for every x in R, although theta targets m/m^2. For x=1 the left side is zero and the asserted right side is nonzero. Step 3.1 constructs D=id-s*pi, which equals x mod m^2 only for x in m. Restrict the displayed equality to x in m, or give the correct general formula. The supplier's short-exact-sequence statement survives this correction; the assigned consumer uses it at F6/Proof 1.1.

The proof says the initial parameter classes y_j span the entire ambient cotangent space. For P=k[x,y], I=(x), q=(x,y)/(x), the ambient regular local ring has cotangent dimension 2, while c=1 and y_1=x spans only the cotangent image of I. Replace the assertion by saying their classes form a basis of (I'+(pR)^2)/(pR)^2. The opened F5/F6 suppliers establish this corrected claim, which suffices for Jacobian independence. The assigned consumer uses the local-chart conclusion at F3/Proof 2.1.
